data.cause: EP05 is most likely stalled on in-flight stage-3 workers, not the MILP plan: it has 94 worker_started versus 84 worker_finished, while several other films were launched manually from stage 3 on the same constrained PC. The logs point to worker/resource contention, but do not prove whether a worker is deadlocked or out of GPU/RAM.
data.fix_now: Check EP05’s process and per-worker logs for the 10 unfinished workers. Stop duplicate or unresponsive stage-3 workers, then resume EP05 from its existing stage-3 state rather than rerunning earlier stages. Temporarily run only one GPU-heavy render/animation job at a time.
data.prevent: Add a machine-wide semaphore for render/animation work across both films, cap stage-3 concurrency to the PC’s measured capacity, and add worker timeouts/heartbeats that log the stuck shot and allow safe retry. Avoid launching overlapping manual stage-3 runs.
